name: IC — Renesas
description: Integrated circuit (IC) component cluster containing surface-mount parts using Renesas footprint patterns such as DFN-6 1.5x1.6mm with 0.5mm pitch.
selection_hints: Verify compatibility with Renesas DFN-6 1.5x1.6mm 0.5mm pitch land patterns.
Ensure surface-mount (SMD) mounting is suitable for the target board layout.
Check part quality tier and legacy distribution source status before selection.
avoid_when: The design requires through-hole components rather than surface-mount devices.
The target PCB layout requires package footprints other than Renesas DFN-6.
Higher quality tier parts than Tier C are required for the project.
